$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F09 hero (H). Temple edges first from darkestshades/brand/lightbox/onyx-emblem/process/cfgs.py. The GCD was re-measured on Oct 19 2026 with tools/photo/temple_gcd.py, which models the temple's face in 3D from its converging edges and checks the model against the old print's proportions. The first placement drew the GCD about 40% too long for the angle at which the temple is seen.

lenses.name: far lens (defocused, cut by the frame edge)

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old logo, near temple
